consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at LA-7202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on LA-7202 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. LA-7202 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 30 March 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on LA-7202 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
